answer: My answer to sybils is Beekeeper honey jar assay sealed by the comb charter — each honey jar is a brood record countersigned by the inspector, so a farm must tend a hundred real hives by hand — which makes the oasis of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the garden is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The plume grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
